r.정치 구도: It went through economic collapse under a long-standing authoritarian government. After US forces seized the president in January 2026, the vice president has been acting president.

t.why: Its oil reserves and its claim to Guyana's Essequibo region draw international attention. Close to 8 million people have left the country.
t.rel: Its claim that Guyana's Essequibo region belongs to it keeps tension high. It long faced off with the United States over sanctions and the regime; after US forces seized the president in January 2026, the vice president has been acting president. Millions have left for neighboring countries in the meantime.
t.know: Its youth orchestra program, El Sistema, has produced world-class conductors.
t.etext: It has the world's largest oil reserves, but mismanagement and sanctions have slashed production. Amid severe inflation, many citizens have left the country.
